_README: Each family DECLARES how it mates and what accessories it needs. Adding a new family = adding data here, never editing match.py. verification: verified = checked against a datasheet, inferred = guess, unknown = placeholder.

DTM.description: Deutsch DTM - miniature, low current signal

M12.description: M12 circular - industrial automation. Mates on CODING + POLES, not cavity count. Cordsets ship pre-terminated so no loose contacts or wedgelocks.

D38999.description: MIL-DTL-38999 - aerospace/defense. Mates on SHELL SIZE + INSERT ARRANGEMENT + KEYING POSITION. Keying is the one people miss - same shell, wrong key, will not mate.
